title: C11 JournalEvent
description: Transcribed from the worked example in Section 3.6. Immutable append-only event log entry; every new pipeline stage or agent invocation in later increments must emit these (Definition of Done, Section 17.5).

tool.description: Increment 6: the tool name requested - present on tool.call/tool.denied events.

detail.description: Increment 6: free text - the denial reason for tool.denied, or which guardrail/violation fired for validation.failure. Section 13.3: "tool.denied events and V4 guardrail violations are monitored" - the denial must be identifiable, not just an opaque outcome=failed.
